resources.string: Categories, backups, voice, language and the rest
Tone, the daily reminder and sounds
The 5-step tour, whenever you want to see it again
The photo stays on this device only: it is not in the backup, and Cryo asks for no permission to see your photos.
Tap any item and Cryo shows where it is. What you already use is ticked.
At most one a day, only about what you don\'t use yet.
Write the way you talk, like “lunch 32.50 debit”, and Cryo fills in the rest.
Tap the microphone in the middle of the bar and say the expense. Holding the button opens the typing field.
In Transactions, tap any entry to change the amount, date or category, or delete it.
Create, rename and pick the colour and icon of your categories. With categories, charts and budgets start working.
Card: the statement and its payment
Each purchase lands on the right statement. When you pay it, record it from the card in Wallet: the account balance and the limit settle.
Add rent, internet and subscriptions. Cryo warns you before the due date and already counts them in the month\'s forecast.
Say how much you want to spend a month in each category. Cryo shows how it should end and warns before you go over.
See every category at once and move budget from one to another for this month only, when one gets tight.
Give a name and an amount to what you are saving for. Cryo shows how much is left and when you get there.
Loans and financing stay apart from the rest. Cryo shows the built-in interest and the best order to pay them off.
In Insights, Cryo shows the most likely result and the range it should fall in, checked against your past months.
A score from 0 to 100 in six parts, with what weighs most now and what to do to improve.
Cryo finds salary, rent and subscriptions by itself, warns when one gets pricier and turns it into a bill with one tap.
Your data only exists on this phone. Pick a folder or your cloud and Cryo keeps a copy by itself.
With the lock on, Cryo asks for your fingerprint, face or phone password every time it opens.
Download the statement in your bank\'s app (OFX, CSV, spreadsheet or PDF) and Cryo reads it all. You review before it goes in.
Before you go shopping, say how much you want to spend. The notification shows live how much is gone and how much is left.
Every now and then, check the value in your bank\'s app and tap “Update value”. With that, Cryo works out the return and where it could get to.
Type the total shown in your bank\'s app. Cryo records the difference as an adjustment on this statement; if you change your mind, just delete the adjustment.
The statement already has that total.
